cat > /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-conf.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
SRC_HOST=10.100.212.10
SRC_PATH=/etc/inventory/app.conf
DST_PATH=/etc/inventory/app.conf
TMP_PATH=/etc/inventory/.app.conf.tmp
KEY=/root/.ssh/id_ed25519
LOG=/var/log/sync-inventory-conf.log

mkdir -p /etc/inventory

ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "root@${SRC_HOST}" "cat ${SRC_PATH}" > "$TMP_PATH" 2>>"$LOG"
RC=$?

if [ $RC -ne 0 ] || [ ! -s "$TMP_PATH" ]; then
    echo "$(date -Iseconds) FAILED to fetch config from ${SRC_HOST} (rc=$RC)" >> "$LOG"
    rm -f "$TMP_PATH"
    exit 1
fi

if [ -f "$DST_PATH" ] && cmp -s "$TMP_PATH" "$DST_PATH"; then
    rm -f "$TMP_PATH"
    exit 0
fi

mv "$TMP_PATH" "$DST_PATH"
chmod 644 "$DST_PATH"
echo "$(date -Iseconds) synced config from ${SRC_HOST} (changed)" >> "$LOG"
exit 0
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
cat /usr/local/bin/sync-inventory-conf.sh
